class A: pass
class B: pass
class X(A,B): pass
class Y(B,A): pass
class Z(X,Y):
    print("body")

class A(3):
    print("body")

x=7
class A:
    print(x)
    x=9
    def f(self): return x
print(A.x,A().f())

def outer(x):
    class A:
        y=x+1
        def f(self): return x
    return A
A=outer(4)
print(A.y,A().f())

def outer(y):
    class A:
        y=1
        def f(self): return y
    return A
A=outer(8)
print(A.y,A().f())

class A: pass
a=A()
a.self=a
A.current=a
print(a.self is a,A.current is a,bool(a),bool(A))
class A(str): pass

class A:
    def __init__(self): self.__x=7
    def f(self): return self.__x
print(A().f())

class Meta(type): pass
class A(metaclass=Meta): pass

y=4
def make(y):
    class A:
        print(y)
        y=1
        def f(self): return y
    return A
A=make(9)
print(A.y,A().f())

class A:
    def __init__(self,x=3): self.x=x
class B(A): pass
b=B(7)
print(b.x,isinstance(b,A),issubclass(B,object),B.__bases__[0] is A)

events=[]
class A: pass
a=A()
a.x=10
def owner():
    events.append(1)
    return a
def rhs():
    events.append(2)
    return 3
owner().x=rhs()
print(events[0],events[1],a.x)
events=[]
owner().x+=rhs()
print(events[0],events[1],a.x)
del owner().x
try: a.x
except AttributeError: print("deleted")
